{{/* layouts/_partials/brew/sidebar-left.html — Quartz left sidebar (SKILL §Scenario F-B) Contains: page title, spacer, search+darkmode+readermode flex row, explorer. Search: brew/search.html (legacy inline UI) + Base caps/search/search-inline.js Explorer: brew/explorer.html (legacy markup); populated by Base caps/explorer/explorer.js. */}} {{- partial "brew/page-title.html" . -}} {{- partial "components/spacer.html" . -}}
{{- $page := . -}} {{- with .Site.Params.search -}} {{- if .enable -}} {{- partial "brew/search.html" $page -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}}
{{- partial "brew/darkmode.html" . -}}
{{- if not (or (in .RelPermalink "/tags/") (in .RelPermalink "/categories/")) -}}
{{- partial "brew/readermode.html" . -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- partial "brew/theme-preset.html" . -}}
{{- if .Site.Params.explorer -}} {{- partial "brew/explorer.html" . -}} {{- end -}} {{- with .Site.Params.navLinks -}}
{{- range . -}} {{- $href := .url | default .href | default "#" -}} {{- $abs := or (hasPrefix $href "http://") (hasPrefix $href "https://") -}} {{ .title | default .name }} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
